description:
Use this when the user wants their brand kit set up or changed: "use this logo for my brand", "my brand
colors are red and white". Anything left out stays as it was. Premium: refused on the free plan before
anything changes. Never reads a file from the user's computer.
Not for: putting the kit on clips (apply_brand_kit) or a one-off caption color (style_clip). Costs no Horizon
Units.

colors.description: The full list of up to 8 brand colors, color names or hex, e.g. ["red", "#FFE600"]. Replaces the old list; an empty list clears it; left out keeps it.

fonts.description: The full list of up to 8 font names from edit_catalog(kind="fonts"), e.g. ["Montserrat"]. Replaces the old list; an empty list clears it; left out keeps it.

logo_url.description: Link to a logo picture to add: https .jpg, .png or .webp, or a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link open to anyone. Empty adds none.

remove_logos.description: Logo ids from get_brand_kit to take out of the kit. Empty or left out removes none.

name: set_brand_kit
title: Change the brand kit
